notes:
0.2.0: fictitious competitors and follow-up of the archers.

Fictitious competitors can be added to a training with an average per arrow: their qualification scores are drawn around it, and they take part in the rankings, the teams and the brackets, without a target nor a scorecard.

The follow-up of the archers shows every shoot of an archer on the server, trainings and real competitions, grouped by situation (format, distances, face) with averages, best and last scores and duels won and lost, a chart of the average per arrow and CSV exports. The results of the trainings are kept by the module, so they stay once a training is deleted from ianseo.

Two new tables of its own, created on the first opening of a page of the module.
uninstall_warning: The trainings already created stay in ianseo as ordinary competitions.
